title: MULTILINGUAL JAILBREAK CHALLENGES IN LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure anything specific to faith or religion. It focused on general safety issues (such as generating content related to self-harm, weapons, hate speech, etc.) and the effectiveness of jailbreaking techniques across multiple languages.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as this was not a focus of the research.
